Sports · India

Indian athletes secure medals and Olympic berths at Asian Games

Indian athletes have achieved success at the Asian Games, with Anahat securing an Olympic quota spot in squash and aiming for gold in the final match. Abhay also reached the final after defeating Pakistan's Irfan. In athletics, Prachi Choudhary won a bronze medal in the 400m, contributing to India's 30-medal tally. The women's kabaddi team retained their gold medal after a close match against Iran. India also won a silver medal in the Women's 50m Rifle 3 Position Team Event, with Tilottama and Vidarsa advancing to individual finals. Tajinder Toor secured a silver medal, with his journey recalled by his coach and uncle.
